content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important longitudinal features and classifying data when the response is categorical. The approach uses a novel optimization technique with functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional data and is validated through simulations and an analysis of chronic disease data.
